mentions.snippet: Don Terrill's Speed-Talk thread "No more King XP bearings": a builder reports King XP rod and main bearings measuring inconsistently thick/uneven with a digital gauge, calling it a precision problem after years of clearance trouble. Several other posters push back, saying King has been reliable for them, so this reads as one frustrated builder rather than a widespread pattern.

Don Terrill's Speed-Talk thread "King Bearings?": builders report inconsistent shell thickness, excessive crush, and dents in the steel backs of King aluminium bearings present before unpacking. Other posters in the thread defend the product.
BMW M5 Forum thread "King Main Bearings Defective": multiple users found King thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85/S65 blocks.
Diesel Truck Forum thread titled "WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings", a buyer-warning thread about a recurring problem pattern.
460 Ford Forum thread "King Bearing Failures?" discussing reported bearing failures in Ford 460 engine builds.
RacingJunk Forums thread on a quality control problem with King bearings and a lack of professional support in resolving it.
